content.label: Examiner note - the sign IS the answer
content.body: On the energy level diagram the products sit BELOW the reactants for an exothermic change and delta H is negative; endothermic is the mirror image, products above, delta H positive. Write the sign even when the number is 'obvious' - '-4817 kJ/mol' and '4817 kJ/mol' are different answers, and the arrow labels (delta H, activation energy) are separately markable.
